rite.prompt: In the opening of this chapter, what does the initiator point the candidate toward when the veil is torn?

signal:
HERMES.NFO                                          HALL 1.3
================================================================
The Life and Teachings of Thoth Hermes Trismegistus
Manly P. Hall · 1928 · folio p.93 · ECHO HERMES.MYST

THESIS
  One figure wearing three names — Thoth, Hermes, Mercurius —
  is the myth the West uses for the inventor of writing, rites,
  and the sciences. Hall reads him as a title, not a biography.

POINTS
  * Poimandres: Nous shows Hermes the seven Governors
  * The Book of Thoth as a lost picture-book of the laws
  * Fragments survive; the system does not
  * Trismegistus = thrice great: king, priest, philosopher
  * The tearing of the temple veil is the first initiation gag

SEE ALSO  pyramid  qabbalah  tarot  cryptogram
DEGREE    NEOPHYTE may read this screen
================================================================
translation:
Hall does not try to prove that a single Egyptian named Thoth lived and taught Pythagoras. He treats Hermes Trismegistus as a job title that got passed down: the mind that invents writing, measures the stars, and hides doctrine in pictures.

The chapter opens as a rite, not a lecture. A candidate in white watches the temple veil torn; the initiator points into the dark and says “Behold the Light of Egypt.” That is Hall’s method in miniature. You are not given a doctrine. You are shown a darkness with a name on it, and told that light used to live there.

What remains of the Hermetic books is wreckage — Greek treatises under the name Hermes, Egyptian priest-craft remembered by Greeks, the Poimandres vision in which Universal Mind shows the seer seven planetary Governors ruling nature. Hall’s claim is that these scraps are leaves from a larger “Book of Thoth,” a pictorial grammar of the world, later disguised as tarot, as alchemy, as the Qabbalistic tree. He will spend the rest of the folio trying to read that grammar in every tradition he can reach.

Read this chapter as the board’s login banner. The rest of the BBS is the attempt to reassemble the book the veil was hiding.
